description: Placeholder duel-slice constants. Combat numbers are synthetic. The tick conversion and the fixed-point format are the sim-core contract, not balance data.
rulesTurnSecondsNote: Named length of one rules-turn. The gameplay reading was about 33 seconds, and 33 is the whole-second fit: 33 × 30 Hz = 990 ticks. A photon arms across two turns (66 s) and a disruptor across one (33 s).
powerRepairNote: Repair restores 1 box every repairEveryTicks. Unset energy priorities are defaultEnergyPriority (1 is highest). Both are placeholders. See docs/rules/needs-ce-reading.md.
lifeSupportNote: Life support 1.5 and fire control 1. Together with movement at 1 per speed point this is the observed systems load: speed + 2.5.
